title: Mugs, Magic, and the First Spark
location: Mugs and Magic Cafe → ISCKON Temple → Jyoti's Flat, Jaipur
caption: A cafe glow, temple calm, and music at her flat made the first day feel like a gentle destiny.
longNote:
Mugs and Magic smelled like new beginnings and warm coffee.
We wandered into ISCKON where everything felt serene and full of positive energy.
Back at her flat, the music softened the night and time slowed down.
It was the first day that felt truly special, like the story had already chosen us.

title: Scooty Rescue & Coffee You Loved
caption: In the middle of city chaos, her help and a simple coffee turned into quiet gratitude.
longNote:
The scooty was towed, and the day could have stayed heavy.
She showed up, steady and calm, helping me recover it.
I made you coffee after, and you smiled in that soft, appreciative way.
That small moment tasted like trust.

title: 2nd February Confession
caption: A tipsy night turned honest, and our feelings finally spoke out loud.
longNote:
On the 2nd of February, you stayed over at my place.
We were both a little drunk, brave in the way only love can make you.
Somewhere between laughter and silence, we confessed what we felt.
That night drew a new map for our hearts.

title: Valentine's at Your Place
caption: We cooked, sipped wine, decorated the room, and said love with every small detail.
longNote:
On Valentine's Day, I stayed at your place and we cooked together.
The room glowed with decorations, and we clicked pictures like keepsakes.
Wine made the night feel softer, our laughter warmer.
We expressed love in the simplest, most perfect ways.

title: Pink City Loops
caption: Scooty rides, cafes, temples, and riverside talks stitched our everyday into magic.
longNote:
We ride the scooty through Jaipur like it belongs to us.
Shopping trips, cafe corners, and temple visits keep our rhythm soft.
We dance, roam the Pink City streets, and laugh at everything.
Even our drunk riverside talks feel like a movie we never want to end.
Staying over and ordering food is its own kind of celebration.

title: A Quiet Promise
caption: She brought stability and warmth, and I want to keep choosing her every day.
longNote:
You made my life feel steady, like the ground finally settled.
Your warmth fills the spaces I didn't know were cold.
With you, even ordinary days feel safe and bright.
I want to keep choosing you, in every season, in every way.
